info.title: BlitzBoard Public API
info.description:
Organization-scoped public integration API for seasons, teams, players, and schedules.
Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer bb_live_...` (API key, not a login JWT).
Generate keys from Organizations → organization detail at https://live.blitzboardstats.com/organizations.
List seasons via GET /v1/blitz-api/seasons and pass `_id` as `season` when creating a team.

tags.name: Seasons
tags.description: List seasons to use when creating teams

tags.name: Teams
tags.description: Team CRUD scoped to the API key organization

ApiKeyBearer.description: Public integration API key (`bb_live_...`). Not a login JWT.

CreateScheduleRequest.description: WARNING: If you do not provide a value for a format field on create, we set a default on our side (eventType=game, duration=30, matchupFormat=halves, teamFormat=7v7, booleans false, overtimeType=unlimited, endDate=startDate+duration). You must still send teamId, startDate, and teamTwoName. If you send a value, we use yours.

teamId.description: Team that owns this schedule. You must send this.

eventType.description: If you do not provide this field, we set `game` on our side.

startDate.description: When the event starts. You must send this.

endDate.description: If you do not provide this field, we set startDate + duration minutes on our side.

teamTwoName.description: Opponent display name. You must send this for a typical game.

duration.description: If you do not provide this field, we set `30` on our side.

matchupFormat.description: If you do not provide this field, we set `halves` on our side.

teamFormat.description: If you do not provide this field, we set `7v7` on our side.

isTestGame.description: If you do not provide this field, we set `false` on our side.

fieldSizeInYard.description: Send when enableYardage is true. If enableYardage is true and you do not provide this field, we set `50` on our side.

enableYardage.description: If you do not provide this field, we set `false` on our side.

isScrimmage.description: If you do not provide this field, we set `false` on our side.

allowZeroYardStart.description: If you do not provide this field, we set `false` on our side.

overtimeType.description: If you do not provide this field, we set `unlimited` on our side.

overtimeDuration.description: Send when overtimeType is limited (minutes). We do not invent a limited overtime length.

Forbidden.description: Outside API key organization scope or insufficient permissions

get.description: List teams for the organization bound to the API key. organizationId is injected from the key.

post.description: Create a team in the API key organization. Do not send organizationId in the body.

Create a single player. Requires header idem-key (or Idempotency-Key): a client-generated unique string for this create intent. Reusing a key that already created a player returns 409 Conflict and does not create a duplicate. Generate a new key for every new player. See Concepts → Idempotency key.

parameters.name: idem-key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique string for this create intent (UUID recommended). Also accepted as Idempotency-Key. Same key reused after a successful create → 409 Conflict (Idempotency key already used). Missing → 400.

get.description: List available seasons. Use `_id` as `season` when creating a team. Optional filters: year, season name.

List schedules across the API key owner's teams in the key organization.

Query `filter`:
- `upcoming` (default) — future schedules that are not live
- `live` — in-progress schedules

Examples: `GET /v1/blitz-api/schedules?filter=upcoming` · `GET /v1/blitz-api/schedules?filter=live`

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: upcoming (default) = future not live; live = in progress

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: Search by event title or team name

parameters.name: tournamentId
parameters.description: Filter by tournament id. Repeat for multiple values.

post.description:
Create a schedule. Pass `teamId` in the body (not the path).

**WARNING:** If you do not provide a value for a format field, we set a default on our side (eventType=`game`, duration=`30`, matchupFormat=`halves`, teamFormat=`7v7`, booleans=`false`, overtimeType=`unlimited`, endDate=`startDate`+duration). You must still send `teamId`, `startDate`, and `teamTwoName`. If you send a value, we use yours. PATCH does not apply these create defaults.

minimal.summary: Minimal create (we fill format fields on our side)

full.summary: Create game with your own format values

get.description: Get one schedule by scheduleId. No teamId required; the schedule must belong to a team in the API key organization.

parameters.name: scheduleId
parameters.description: Schedule document Mongo `_id` from create or list.

patch.description:
Update a schedule by scheduleId. Pass teamId in the request body.

**WARNING:** If you do not send a field on PATCH, we leave the existing value unchanged. We do not apply create defaults.

parameters.name: scheduleId
parameters.description: Schedule document Mongo `_id` from create or list.

delete.description: Soft-delete a schedule by scheduleId. Pass teamId as a query parameter.

parameters.name: scheduleId
parameters.description: Schedule document Mongo `_id` from create or list.
